name: i484-engineering
description: Compound Engineering with i484 specialist skills for product design and visual artifacts

scripts.plugin:validate: claude plugin validate --strict .claude-plugin/marketplace.json && claude plugin validate --strict .claude-plugin/plugin.json
scripts.site:build: cd site && bundle exec jekyll build --strict_front_matter
scripts.site:check: cd site && LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 bundle exec htmlproofer _site --disable-external --allow-missing-href --no-enforce-https --swap-urls '^/i484-engineering/:/'
scripts.site:serve: cd site && bundle exec jekyll serve --livereload
scripts.site:test: cd site && bundle exec rake test
scripts.test:skill-guards: bun run scripts/run-tests.ts skill-conventions codex-skill-prompt-budget repo-local-ce-skill-work contract
